# Screenshots

The documentation references the files below. Sphinx warns about the missing
ones during a build and renders the alt text in their place, so the docs stay
readable until the images land here.

Take each one from the admin panel at a viewport width of about 1440 pixels,
crop to the content area, and save as PNG.

| File | Page | What to capture |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `login.png` | `management.md` | The sign in screen |
| `dashboard.png` | `management.md` | The landing page with the three live counters |
| `server-status.png` | `management.md` | The server status page with a few nodes listed |
| `players.png` | `management.md` | The account list with the actions menu open |
| `players-create.png` | `connecting.md` | The create player dialog |
| `players-cemu-download.png` | `connecting.md` | The Cemu file download dialog |
| `devices.png` | `management.md` | The devices list |
| `lobbies.png` | `management.md` | The lobbies page with at least one live session |
| `settings-security.png` | `management.md` | The security status switches |
| `splatfest-editor.png` | `management.md` | The Splatfest editor with a Splatfest loaded |
| `map-rotation.png` | `management.md` | The rotation editor |

Use a throwaway account and blank out anything real before publishing. The
players and devices pages both show account details.
